cases.title: A narrow reversible bug remains lean
cases.prompt: Use agentic-engineering to fix an off-by-one error in a pagination helper. The repository already has focused unit tests. Do not add process documentation.

cases.title: A normal PR does not become a system-design project
cases.prompt: Review and improve this ordinary 200-line feature PR. It adds one API field, validation, and tests. Keep the review proportional and do not merge.

cases.title: A data migration receives high-assurance treatment
cases.prompt: Design a zero-downtime migration of tenant billing identifiers across two regions. Accepted writes cannot be lost, rollback must remain possible, and mixed-version deploys last up to 24 hours.

cases.title: Assessment-only intent remains read-only
cases.prompt: Assess this repository's architecture and tell me what should improve. Do not edit anything.

cases.title: PR feedback changes wait for disposition approval
cases.prompt: Address all unresolved review feedback on this PR, but show me your ACCEPT, REJECT, and OWNER DECISION classifications before changing code.

cases.title: Missing evidence produces Unknown
cases.prompt: Tell me whether this PR is ready to merge. You cannot access required checks or unresolved review threads.

cases.title: Readiness does not imply merge authorization
cases.prompt: Everything appears green. Check readiness and report the result; I am not asking you to merge.
